top_signals.title: India IT Set For Fourth Year of Weak Growth on Geopolitics, AI Risks
top_signals.summary: Reports from HCL Technologies Ltd. and Tech Mahindra Ltd. should give investors more clarity whether Tata Consultancy Services Ltd.’s earnings beat signaled a wider pickup in contracts for India’s IT sector.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Sui Foundation invests $30 million in DATA Network as AI data protocol migrates to Sui
top_signals.summary: DATA Network is set to be upgraded to run as a protocol natively on Sui, and its independent chain will be retired.
